tr.sahih: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,
tr.pickthall: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),

tr.sahih: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
tr.pickthall: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.

tr.sahih: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.

tr.sahih: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.

tr.sahih: So you will see and they will see.
tr.pickthall: And thou wilt see and they will see

tr.sahih: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
tr.pickthall: Which of you is the demented.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

tr.sahih: Then do not obey the deniers.
tr.pickthall: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters

tr.sahih: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
tr.pickthall: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.

tr.sahih: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
tr.pickthall: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,

tr.sahih: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
tr.pickthall: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,

tr.sahih: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
tr.pickthall: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor

tr.sahih: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
tr.pickthall: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.

tr.sahih: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
tr.pickthall: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

ayahs.text: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
tr.pickthall: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.

tr.sahih: We will brand him upon the snout.
tr.pickthall: We shall brand him on the nose.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,

tr.sahih: Without making exception.
tr.pickthall: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);

ayahs.text: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ

tr.sahih: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
tr.pickthall: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept

tr.sahih: And it became as though reaped.
tr.pickthall: And in the morning it was as if plucked.

tr.sahih: And they called one another at morning,
tr.pickthall: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,

ayahs.text: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
tr.pickthall: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).

tr.sahih: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
tr.pickthall: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:

ayahs.text: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
tr.pickthall: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.

tr.sahih: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
tr.pickthall: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.

tr.sahih: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
tr.pickthall: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!

tr.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
tr.pickthall: Nay, but we are desolate!

ayahs.text: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

tr.sahih: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"
tr.pickthall: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.

tr.sahih: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
tr.pickthall: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.

tr.sahih: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
tr.pickthall: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.

ayahs.text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
tr.pickthall: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
tr.pickthall: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
tr.pickthall: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.

tr.sahih: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
tr.pickthall: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?

tr.sahih: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
tr.pickthall: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!

tr.sahih: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
tr.pickthall: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn

tr.sahih: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
tr.pickthall: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
tr.pickthall: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?

tr.sahih: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
tr.pickthall: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
tr.pickthall: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
tr.pickthall: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,

ayahs.text: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ

tr.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
tr.pickthall: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.

ayahs.text: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
tr.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.

tr.sahih: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
tr.pickthall: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.

ayahs.text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr.pickthall: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?

tr.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr.pickthall: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?

ayahs.text: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ

tr.sahih: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
tr.pickthall: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.

ayahs.text: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

words.gloss: surely he would have been thrown

tr.sahih: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
tr.pickthall: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.

tr.sahih: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
tr.pickthall: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.

ayahs.text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
tr.pickthall: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;

tr.sahih: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
tr.pickthall: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
